description: Timed on-chain Sudoku with provably fair puzzle deals. Pay a small GAS entry, receive a puzzle seeded from an immutable block beacon, and solve it before the deadline to win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Easy, 0.5 for Medium, 1 for Hard. Placements are final — each on-chain undo rescues your board but burns 30% of the base reward (three max). Winnings accrue as withdrawable credit and every solve is ranked on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 限时链上数独，牌局可验证公平。支付少量 GAS 报名费后，合约用不可变的区块信标派发谜题种子，在截止时间内完成即可赢取固定 GAS 奖励：简单 0.1、中等 0.5、困难 1。落子即锁定——每次链上撤回可挽救棋盘，但会扣除基础奖励的 30%（最多三次）。奖金以可提取余额累计，每次通关都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: Puzzle seeds come from a fixed block-beacon commit/reveal: the seed hashes the first block after the start transaction with the player and game id, so neither side can pick a puzzle. Seed grinding cannot mint rewards here — any seed still yields a puzzle that must be solved within the same limits. Morpheus VRF + TEE puzzle sealing is the planned upgrade path for server-private deals.

tee.description: The play session is verified by Morpheus TEE compute before settlement, with the contract bound to the configured Morpheus oracle kernel on testnet.
